name: Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten Kempinski Munich
positioning: Historic grand hotel on Maximilianstrasse in central Munich, founded in 1858 and part of Kempinski
best_for: Culture lovers who want a short walk to the Bavarian State Opera
Guests who want a suite with butler service

facts.text: The hotel was founded in 1858 at the explicit wish of King Maximilian II.
The hotel is on Maximilianstrasse, a boulevard in the heart of Munich, amid designer boutiques, art galleries and theatres.
The Bavarian State Opera (Nationaltheater) is a short walk of about 3 minutes from the hotel.
The English Garden is about 10 minutes on foot from the hotel.
The Maximilian Suite has a 40 sq m private terrace.
The Theresien Suite has its own private sauna, a wine cooler and a personal humidor.
Butler service is complimentary for guests of the Theresien, Maximilian and Ludwig Suites.
Schwarzreiter Restaurant is the hotel's fine dining venue, serving modern interpretations of young Bavarian cuisine built on seasonal ingredients.
In-house guests have complimentary access to the spa's indoor pool, fitness center, sauna and steam bath.
Dogs are welcome and receive a blanket and a feeding bowl, with an additional fee per dog per stay.

highlights.text: The three-bedroom Ludwig Suite was conceived by interior designer Colin Finnegan as a tribute to King Ludwig II and overlooks Maximilianstrasse.
Kempinski The Spa sits above the rooftops of Munich and has an exclusive partnership with the Swiss skincare brand La Prairie.
The guest service team, known as the Ladies and Gentlemen in Red, wears distinctive red attire and arranges restaurant reservations, private transfers, sightseeing and opera tickets.
Jahreszeiten Bar & Lobby serves afternoon tea, classic cocktails and late-night refreshments.
The Oktoberfest costume parade passes directly by the hotel along Maximilianstrasse.

considerations.text: The hotel's facilities are not fully accessible; individual arrangements are made as far as the building allows.
Pets are not allowed in the Jahreszeiten Bar, the Schwarzreiter Restaurant or Kempinski The Spa.
Underground parking is available at a surcharge.
